groups.title: Team Avatar
groups.def: Aang's core group of traveling companions for most or all of the series: the four friends who never leave, Zuko and Suki who join partway through, and the two animal companions. Does not include short-term allies who only helped for a single arc like the invasion (Haru, Teo, The Duke, Pipsqueak).

groups.title: Firebenders
groups.def: Every non-Avatar character confirmed on screen to firebend. Chit Sang firebends at the Boiling Rock; Lo and Li are nonbenders who only coach Azula, so they're out.

groups.title: Fire Nation Royal Family
groups.def: Every member of the Fire Nation's ruling family by birth or marriage who is shown or named on screen, through Zuko's generation.

groups.title: Named animals
groups.def: Named, ordinary (non-spirit) animals who appear in the show.

groups.title: Waterbenders
groups.def: Every non-Avatar character confirmed on screen to waterbend.

groups.title: Order of the White Lotus
groups.def: Named members of the secret Order of the White Lotus who liberate Ba Sing Se in the finale.

groups.title: Freedom Fighters
groups.def: Official members of Jet's band of Earth Kingdom resistance fighters.

groups.title: Earthbenders
groups.def: Every non-Avatar character confirmed on screen to earthbend, including the Earth Rumble VI tournament fighters.

groups.title: Fire Lords
groups.def: Characters who officially hold the title of Fire Lord at some point in the show. Azula is crowned but never completes the ceremony, so she doesn't count.

groups.title: Katara and Sokka's Family
groups.def: Katara and Sokka's blood relatives shown in the series.

groups.title: Sword Fighters
groups.def: Characters shown fighting with a sword on screen: Sokka (the sword Piandao trains him with), Zuko's dual dao, Jet's hook swords, Piandao, and Suki's katana against Azula. Knives and daggers (Mai, Smellerbee, Azula's knife), war fans (Kyoshi) and spears or clubs (The Duke, Pipsqueak) don't count.

groups.title: Water Tribe
groups.def: Every character affiliated with the Water Tribe, Northern or Southern, including the Foggy Swamp offshoot tribe.

groups.title: Past Avatars
groups.def: Incarnations of the Avatar spirit who appear in the series: Aang and the four lives immediately before him.

groups.title: Spirits
groups.def: Spirit-world beings, plus Yue, who dies and becomes the new Moon Spirit. Does not include past Avatars, who are a separate concept in the show.

groups.title: Boiling Rock
groups.def: Everyone seen at the Boiling Rock prison in the two-part "The Boiling Rock": the warden, the inmates Suki, Hakoda and Chit Sang, Sokka and Zuko (undercover), and Azula, Mai and Ty Lee, who arrive in Part 2. The rest of Team Avatar stays at the Western Air Temple.

groups.title: Team Avatar's Teachers
groups.def: Outside masters who willingly and personally train a Team Avatar member in bending or combat, not counting an adversary who forces a lesson (like Hama).

groups.title: Agni Kai Fighters
groups.def: Characters confirmed to have fought an on-screen Agni Kai duel. Only three are depicted, and Zuko fights in all of them.

groups.title: Earth Rumble Contestants
groups.def: Everyone who fought in the Earth Rumble VI underground earthbending tournament in Gaoling.

groups.title: No Real Name Given
groups.def: Characters known only by a title, occupation, or nickname — no birth name is ever given on screen.

groups.title: Team Avatar's invasion allies
groups.def: Named characters outside Team Avatar who take part in the Day of Black Sun invasion force: Hakoda, Haru, The Duke, Pipsqueak, The Boulder, The Hippo, the Mechanist and the swamp waterbenders Huu, Due and Tho. Team Avatar's own members aren't counted; Bumi freeing Omashu and Iroh breaking out of prison during the eclipse don't count; Suki is in the Boiling Rock at the time.

groups.title: Lightning benders
groups.def: Characters shown generating or redirecting lightning on screen: Iroh, Ozai and Azula generate it; Iroh, Zuko and Aang (against Ozai in the finale) redirect it. Combustion Man's blasts and Sozin redirecting lava heat don't count.

groups.title: Starred in a Tale of Ba Sing Se
groups.def: Characters who get their own segment in "The Tales of Ba Sing Se" (Toph and Katara share one). Appa's story is the following episode, "Appa's Lost Days", so he doesn't count.

groups.title: Wore Kyoshi Warrior makeup
groups.def: Characters seen in the Kyoshi Warriors' face paint and green armor: Suki, Sokka (training with them in "The Warriors of Kyoshi"), Azula, Mai and Ty Lee (disguised as the warriors in Ba Sing Se; Ty Lee later joins for real), and Avatar Kyoshi, whose own look the uniform copies.

groups.title: Team Avatar's parents
groups.def: Parents of a Team Avatar member who appear or are named on screen: Hakoda and Kya (Katara and Sokka), Lao and Poppy Beifong (Toph), Ozai and Ursa (Zuko). Aang's and Suki's parents never appear; uncle Iroh and grandmother Kanna aren't parents.

groups.title: Siblings
groups.def: Characters shown or stated on screen to have a brother or sister: Katara and Sokka, Zuko and Azula, Iroh and Ozai, Mai (baby brother Tom-Tom), Ty Lee (six identical sisters) and the twin sisters Lo and Li. Siblings that exist only in comics or novels (Sozin's, Roku's, Zhao's) don't count, and the warden is only ever called Mai's uncle.

groups.title: Aang's bending teachers
groups.def: Characters who give Aang bending lessons on screen: Katara and Pakku (water), Toph (earth), Jeong Jeong and Zuko (fire). Guru Pathik teaches chakras, not bending; Bumi never becomes his teacher; the past Avatars only give advice.

groups.title: Dead before the show begins
groups.def: Characters already dead when the series opens, seen only in flashbacks or as spirits: Kya, Lu Ten, Sozin, Azulon and Aang's four past lives. Ursa is alive (banished); Jet, Yue and Zhao are lost during the series.
